svg.title: Tools lie along routes to separate goals
svg.desc: Place common resources between several distinct origins and their separate goals. Arrows continue beyond the resource boxes so useful means cannot read as final objectives.

**Frame:** On the legal pad, many task arrows converge on small boxes labeled `SHARED STATE`, `PEER KNOWLEDGE`, `TIME`, and `ACCESS`. The boxes remain tools along routes to other goals.

**Action:** Curt redraws recurrence as a resource pattern.

**Dialogue — CURT:**
> And they keep discovering the same kinds of prerequisites.

**Provenance:** `reconstructed` + `inferred` — dialogue and diagram express the project's instrumental-convergence interpretation.

", "title": "Tools lie along routes to separate goals" } }
